# Medfemme Women's Clinic

> Medfemme is a women's health clinic in Kanpur, India, led by Dr. Priyanka Bhargava — a gynecologist and obstetrician with over 20 years of experience. The clinic provides obstetrics & maternity care, high-risk pregnancy management, gynecology, infertility treatment, laparoscopic surgery, and cosmetic gynecology.

## About

Medfemme Women's Clinic offers comprehensive care for women at every stage of life, from adolescent gynecology to pregnancy, menopause, and wellness. Dr. Priyanka Bhargava specializes in PMOS(PCOS), high-risk pregnancy, IVF and fertility care, menstrual disorders, endometriosis, fibroids, and minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery.
